fullContentHtml:
BPSC ASO Mains Result 2026 – Full Details

Bihar Public Service Commission (BPSC) has released the Mains Result for the post of Assistant Section Officer ASO (Sahaayak Prashaakha Padaadhikaaree) (Advt.No:37/2025). This recruitment was released for 41 posts. Applications for the BPSC ASO Recruitment 2025 were accepted from January 12, 2026, to January 31, 2026. The mains examination was conducted on 27 February 2026. Candidates who appeared for this examination can download their BPSC ASO Mains Result 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 22 May 2025
  • Application Start Date : 29 May 2025
  • Last Date : 23 June 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 23 June 2025
  • Exam Date : 10 September 2025
  • Admit Card : 04 September 2025
  • Answer Key : 18 September 2025
  • Pre OMR Sheet : 22-28 October 2025
  • Pre Final Answer Key : 01 November 2025
  • Pre Result : 23 December 2025
  • Mains Online Form
  • Start Date : 12 January 2026
  • Last Date : 31 January 2026
  • Mains Exam Date : 27 February 2026
  • Mains Admit Card : 20 February 2026
  • Final Answer Key : 06 April 2026
  • Mains Result : 27 October 2026

Application Fee

  • General, OBC, EWS, Other Candidates : Rs. 600/-
  • SC, ST, Female Candidates of Bihar : Rs. 150/-
  • PH Candidates : Rs. 200/-

How to Check Result

  1. Click on the direct official result link provided below.
  2. Enter your Roll Number / Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  3. Submit the form to view your scorecard on screen.
  4. Download and print a copy of the result for future reference.
